usedFor: ActiveCampaign holds your contacts and Nutshell holds your companies, so “New Contact” can seed “Create Company” records.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in ActiveCampaign, then “Create Company” in Nutshell
bestTemplate.why: Every new contact gets a company record in Nutshell, so sales starts from one place.

watchOut: Each “New Contact” creates a company, so a second contact at the same business can add a duplicate.
